integrity: An explicit uniform modular-arithmetic proof and a standalone exact finite verifier are supplied. Claims of independent auditing, originality certification and external proof checking are not made.
scientific_limitations: Proved for generalized quaternion groups of order \(2N\) with \(N=2^k\) and \(k\ge3\), not for the quaternion group of order eight or other two-groups. Exact priority against all older holomorph and automorphism-group literature is not independently established. Finite enumeration confirms only \(3\le k\le8\).
title: Involution clique geometry of generalized quaternion automorphism groups
